go_criteria: (a) OOS Sharpe > max(orderflow-only, flat) on both windows
(b) paired permutation p < 0.05 vs that control on both windows
(c) block-bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0 on both windows
(d) >=2 distinct time-varying levels with |IC| > 1e-9 on both windows
pre_declared.slice_policy: full_tape (the aligned signal saturates in the tail, so no fixed tail slice is used)

provenance_caveats: Public read-only OKX exports; no signed venue attestation.
Options snapshots are OKX option candle closes with reconstructed bid/ask spreads (price_mode=candle_close_with_reconstructed_spread); mid-price parity is meaningful, the bid-ask bound test is not.
Inverse BTC-USD-SWAP orderflow tape vs spot option snapshots.
verdict_reason: No options-only variant passed all four criteria on both windows. Best mean OOS Sharpe = options_only_short_thresh0.2 (1.341202); per-window details in the artifact.
